text:
jamie: quick sync — monitoring workbench kickoff. Need owners and hit list for dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and a retention decision. TL;DR milestones: 1) rough dashboard wireframes by Wed, 2) tracing hooks instrumented in core services by next Fri, 3) retention policy decided and communicated EOW. Blocking deps: storage sizing from eng-infra, and a canary plan from SRE. Who can own which?

maria: I can take dashboard wireframes. Will share an initial Figma by Tue EOD. Do we want per-route latency + per-model cost breakdowns on the top-level?

jamie: yes per-route latency is must. per-model cost is nice-to-have, maybe second pass. Thanks for taking it.

sahil: I can lead tracing hooks. Plan: add OpenTelemetry spans in runtime + add trace ids to existing logs. Target services: api-gateway, router, runtime-proxy. Will open PRs with A/B-style feature flags.

leo: eng-infra (me) — storage sizing: need expected retention delta. What TTL are you thinking? current default is 7d for traces.

maria: prefer 30d for traces used in recent regressions, but maybe sampled. Proposal: full traces 7d, sampled long-tail traces 30d for the first pass.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "New canary cluster ready in us-west-2 — tag: workbench-canary-2025-03"

jamie: canary plan: SRE + eng-platform to run smoke suite + trace validation. @leo can you reserve the canary and confirm cost?

leo: reserving now. rough cost estimate ~ $120/day while active. I'll flag finance if we keep longer.

maria: Figma link (WIP): https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/workbench — comments welcome. Focused on a single-pane top-level with quick-filters.

sahil: quick q on trace header propagation — do we standardize on "x-trace-id" or follow w3c traceparent? I'd prefer w3c for interop.

jamie: go w3c traceparent for new work. Add a tiny adapter at ingress to accept legacy x-trace-id and map it.

maria: noted — will add a widget for trace links that uses w3c IDs.

jamie: owners summary: dashboards = maria, tracing hooks = sahil, storage/infra = leo, canary/SLO validation = SRE (cc @ops-bot). Retention policy: provisional: full traces 7d, sampled 30d. Need ENG signoff before EOW.

sahil: opening PRs for api-gateway + runtime-proxy today. Will tag reviewers (maria, jamie).

leo: infra action: allocate extra 200GB for canary retention, set TTL configurable via env var TRACING_TTL_DAYS.

maria: quick review ask: @jamie can you skim the dashboard wireframe tomorrow morning? I want to lock widgets before I hand off to design.

jamie: will do — 10:30am PT. Also adding a short checklist in the repo: 
```
- wireframe approved
- tracing PRs merged
- canary run green
- retention TTL set
- runbook updated
```

ops-bot: runbook-bot: "Reminder: add runbook section 'workbench-traces' with playbook steps and fallback model mapping."

jamie: final ask — if anyone has cross-team deps (billing, legal for data retention), drop them here. Otherwise we'll try to lock signoff by Friday and cut the first canary on Monday.

maria: tagging finance & legal offline; will ping here once I have answers. :thumbsup:

sahil: putting PR links here when ready.

leo: will post infra PR and terraform diff later today.

jamie: thanks all. I'll post a 1-line status update on Friday in eng-platform.
